Summary: Manages student prerequisite data including health and safety requirements.
Purpose: Track and update various student-related prerequisites necessary for participation in certain activities or programs.
Fields: Various health and safety parameters for students.
Workflows: Search and update student prerequisite records.
Validate health and safety data inputs.
Validations: Checks for date ranges and data consistency.
Calculations: Formatting and calculation of dates for safety records.
Conditions: Conditional logic based on health status and compliance.
System Behavior: Database interactions for updating and retrieving student prerequisite data.
Dependencies: Uses HSPnet frameworks, date formatter, and other utility classes.
Exceptions: Errors related to incorrect or outdated data entries.
